services.name: Auth Service
services.description: Handles authentication, session validation, and token refresh for all user-facing apps.

services.name: API Gateway
services.description: Routes external traffic to internal services.

services.name: Redis Cache
services.description: Session and auth token cache layer.

services.name: Payments Service
services.description: Invoice rendering, PDF cache, payment confirmation emails, and the payment-worker that handles POST /settlements settlement timeouts and retries.

services.name: Settlement API
services.description: Downstream settlement-api called by payment-worker for POST /settlements.

pull_requests.title: Cache invalidation update
pull_requests.summary: Updates Redis cache invalidation strategy for auth session keys after TTL changes.

pull_requests.title: Session expiry guardrails
pull_requests.summary: Adds guardrails around session expiry edge cases during token refresh.

pull_requests.title: Document TTL in auth runbook
pull_requests.summary: Adds TTL, session TTL, and token TTL terminology to the auth operator runbook. No runtime behavior change.

pull_requests.title: TTL dashboard labels
pull_requests.summary: Renames Grafana panels to Session TTL, Refresh TTL, and Redis TTL for auth metrics.

pull_requests.title: TTL FAQ for support
pull_requests.summary: Support FAQ explaining what TTL means for login sessions. Docs only.

pull_requests.title: Invoice PDF cache TTL
pull_requests.summary: Raises invoice PDF cache TTL from 1 hour to 24 hours in Payments Service.

pull_requests.title: Reduce payment-worker settlement retries
pull_requests.summary: Changed payment-worker retry policy for POST /settlements from 3 attempts to 1. Correlated with elevated TimeoutException and P95 latency on settlement-api.

incidents.title: Auth failures on login
incidents.summary: Elevated login failures traced to stale session cache entries after deploy.

incidents.title: Token refresh timeout
incidents.summary: Users intermittently fail token refresh under load; investigating Redis TTL parity.

incidents.title: Elevated error rate
incidents.summary: Auth service error rate spike linked to downstream user service latency.

incidents.title: Session invalidation cascade
incidents.summary: Session invalidation bug caused widespread auth failures similar to TTL mismatch scenarios.

incidents.title: TTL scrape delay
incidents.summary: Prometheus scrape delay made auth TTL gauges look stale. Monitoring only; sessions were fine.

incidents.title: TTL alert noise
incidents.summary: Noisy TTL alerts on auth from a misconfigured threshold. No user impact.

incidents.title: TTL log spam
incidents.summary: Debug logging printed TTL on every auth request and filled disk.

incidents.title: Redis eviction after lifetime increase
incidents.summary: Raising identity credential lifetime caused Redis to evict hot keys and cascade login failures. Fix required eviction policy, not just the application constant.

incidents.title: Invoice PDF TTL mismatch
incidents.summary: Payments PDF cache TTL did not match invoice regeneration, serving stale bills. Unrelated to authentication.

incidents.title: payment-worker settlements TimeoutException
incidents.summary: payment-worker P95 latency spike with TimeoutException on POST /settlements. Introduced after PR #8831 reduced retries from 3 to 1. Mitigated by verifying settlement-api health then restarting payment-worker after confirming no poisoned queue depth. Runbook section 4.2.

adrs.title: Auth ownership model
adrs.content: Auth Service is owned by Platform Team. High-risk auth changes require owner review and security sign-off.

adrs.title: Redis TTL strategy
adrs.content: Auth session keys in Redis must use a max TTL of 48 hours unless explicitly approved by Platform Team. Cache invalidation must preserve parity across auth nodes.

adrs.title: Q4 identity lifetime freeze
adrs.content: During quarter close, identity credential lifetime for customer logins stays at 48 hours for finance audit. Extending that lifetime needs Platform plus finance approval.

adrs.title: Invoice PDF cache policy
adrs.content: Payments invoice PDFs may cache at most 24 hours. Do not reuse Auth Service lifetime rules.

adrs.title: payment-worker settlements on-call runbook
adrs.content: Runbook 4.2 for payment-worker POST /settlements timeouts: (1) confirm settlement-api is not degraded, (2) check queue depth and poison messages, (3) restore retries only with Fintech owner approval, (4) restart payment-worker after verifying no write amplification. Owned by Fintech Team.
